services.name: Greenville County EMS

45045.page_note: Greenville County EMS is the county's 911 ambulance service and also runs the county's EMS dispatch centre (MedCom). Prisma Health Ambulance Service also holds a state ambulance licence in the county; its administrator describes its role as moving patients in and out of Prisma Health facilities, not running a county's 911 operations (The State, April 2026). Prisma Health Ambulance Service also lists 911 response among its services and in June 2025 described reaching heatstroke patients on Jones Gap trails in Greenville County, so whether it answers any 911 calls in the county is not yet confirmed.
